content_blocks.label: clause_1._TESTAMENTARY_DISPOSITION
content_blocks.text: I direct that my estate shall be distributed as follows: all real property to my daughter, Lily White; all personal property to my son, Jack White.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._EXECUTOR
content_blocks.text: My executor is to be my son, Jack White, who shall settle my estate and carry out my wishes.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._ALTERATIONS
content_blocks.text: This will may be altered, revoked, or canceled only by a subsequent will executed in accordance with the laws of Maplewood County, State of Verano.
